author: Khan Academy
description:
Check out our latest assessment feature: Explain Your Thinking (EYT)! In this video, Peter from the Khan Academy assessments team introduces Khanductor, our new AI assessment facilitator designed to gauge a student's conceptual understanding through interactive follow-up chats. Unlike other AI tools, Khanductor is trained to probe for deeper insights without providing hints, ensuring valid and reliable results that surface partial understandings or misconceptions. Discover how EYT is capturing valuable data on metacognition and helping students correct their own mistakes in real-time.

For more information on how Khan Academy is revolutionizing student learning through assessments, email us at districts@khanacademy.org
title: Explain Your Thinking - Khan Academy Interim Assessments

author: Khan Academy
description:
After taking the MCAT twice, this learner shifted from passive review to a more active study routine: watch a lesson, revisit the concept, then reinforce it with practice.

Khan Academy MCAT Prep is free, self-paced, developed in collaboration with the AAMC, and designed to align with the MCAT Official Content Outline. Use it alongside your broader study plan as a reference when a specific topic needs another pass.

Explore Khan Academy MCAT Prep!
title: Watching a video can help a concept click. Practicing with questions can help make it stick.
